comparisons.note: ABBA uses the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a significance test. Actual binding ratios use separate single-process measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source-paired reports verify resolution-disabled control equality and full values/metadata/cost/error prefixes. Matching binding/state cases have identical current physical plans and EXPLAIN across sources and runtimes; different bindings may choose different plans. Separate physical-disabled observations require actual saved builtin-root hits and reduced original compilation. The fixed LEFT case still invokes fresh physical planning. Call totals include main, resolution-only and mutation traces. Column/source metadata share one independently recounted allowance. Weak-reference observations follow completed-thread exit and GC and are reported verbatim.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.

harness_smoke.note: Successful untimed baseline and final YJIT fixture smokes precede pins and the 24 formal commands. Both complete outcomes and supervisor reports are retained. Any preceding failed attempts remain separate from these passing runs.

smoke_correction.explanation: First lower() execution lazily initializes @environment; the guarded resolution entry is correctly replaced on the second execution. Initial proof incorrectly required survival of the first cold entry. Corrected proof requires a retained entry repeated from the preceding execution plus an actual saved builtin-root identity hit and fewer original compile calls.
